title: She Gave Him a Piggyback Ride… Then This Happened
caption:
She carried him home after badminton… then gravity won
After practice she gave him a piggyback ride down the long stairway, missed a step, and they both tumbled as her tears spilled out
He got up without a scratch and just patted her head, saying it's okay, he is not hurt
Who's the person that always catches you when you fall?
Share this with your ride-or-die bestie 💛
